Wait, [url=https://i.redd.it/dgxbrx7uwxty.jpg][i]Pocket?[/i][/url] Indeed. I had hoped to release the greener Gameboy Classic preset first, but its awful blurry, prone to ghosting screen has proved a lot harder to emulate than the crispy clear Gameboy Pocket. So this one's coming out first.


To install, simply extract to the game folder. Run (or restart) ENBInjector every new instance you plan to run the game, then run the game's executable afterwards. Make your life easier by linking shortcuts to both files on your desktop. Will update this page soon with fancier instructions.

Have a problem? Read the stickied FAQ in the comment section.
